# Trich Reset

> Trich Reset is an Android app for trichotillomania (hair pulling disorder): guided audio for the moment an urge arrives, urge and pull logging, recovery-aware streaks and lessons. Made by Lux Innovations, Australia.

## Learn (research-sourced guides)

- [What is trichotillomania?](https://trichreset.com/what-is-trichotillomania): Trichotillomania is a recurring urge to pull out your own hair. Around 1.7% of adults have it. Symptoms, causes, focused vs automatic pulling and diagnosis, with research sources.
- [Trichotillomania treatments compared](https://trichreset.com/trichotillomania-treatment): What actually works for hair pulling? Habit reversal training, the ComB model and acceptance-based therapy compared, with the research behind each and where an app fits.
- [Apps for trichotillomania, compared](https://trichreset.com/trichotillomania-apps): Most trich apps help you count your pulling. One is built to get you through the urge. A sourced side-by-side of Trich Reset, TrichStop, SkinAware and HabitAware Keen2.
- [How to stop pulling your hair](https://trichreset.com/how-to-stop-pulling-hair): Practical, research-based steps to stop pulling your hair: spot your triggers, use a competing response, change your setup and ride out the urge. Includes a trigger-to-tool table.
- [Trichotillomania and ADHD](https://trichreset.com/trichotillomania-and-adhd): Up to 3 in 10 adults with trichotillomania also report ADHD. Why hair pulling and ADHD overlap, and practical tools that suit an ADHD brain, with research sources.
